description:
## [1.2.0](https://github.com/sarvottam99/SARVO-Patches/compare/v1.1.1...v1.2.0) (2026-11-04)

### ✨ New Features

* add curated Good Lock module catalogue ([fba62f4](https://github.com/sarvottam99/SARVO-Patches/commit/fba62f4e057307fe6bfceb225ecde0e1395f16eb))
* add remaining Good Lock modules ([8b036bb](https://github.com/sarvottam99/SARVO-Patches/commit/8b036bba4f347d78d00ee7c8432b4c903dd7f7cd))
* add Samsung Good Lock module support ([f291ae3](https://github.com/sarvottam99/SARVO-Patches/commit/f291ae3b6d8ffccd6414544f7df5e0d4eb00ad89))
* add Samsung Good Lock QuickStar patch ([5421805](https://github.com/sarvottam99/SARVO-Patches/commit/542180506c1009e5cbe89411830abb1f83f85ce3))

patches.name: Change installer source
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source so the app appears to be installed from an app store.

patches.name: Dark mode
patches.description: Forces MirAIe into night mode, enables Android Force Dark, darkens its legal WebView, and keeps energy-chart labels readable.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting

patches.name: Hide Lifestyle tab
patches.description: Hides only the Lifestyle tab from MirAIe's bottom navigation. Other tabs, icons and their order remain unchanged.

patches.name: Remove dashboard promotional banner
patches.description: Removes the dashboard promotional carousel before it initializes.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Spoofs the package signature of the original APK.

patches.name: Unlock all Samsung Good Lock modules
patches.description: Show all Good Lock modules irrespective of Samsung official device compatibility. They may or may not work depending on your device Android and/or UI version or other factors. You need to install unsupported modules separately from apk files from the internet.

release_notes: - Added Unlock all Samsung Good Lock modules patch for Samsung Good Lock.
